Antiphonal choirs and breath hockets govern performance; luminous friction, bubbling micro-cells, and spring-loaded impacts provide kinetic motion. caption: An avant-garde chamber art-rock collision of trashy spectacle and obsessive fixation. Built on prime-limit tuning, co-prime rhythmic interlocks, and antiphonal choir counterpoint, the track transforms the sovereign seed into a fast, highly kinetic structural engine. Sound sources include Kamancheh, Clavioline, DTMF touch-tones, contact-mic tables, and Cuatro. Vocals use Ubykh-Hungarian mouth mechanics with breath hockets, creating an ecstatic, luminous, and relentlessly demanding performance.
